data.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Karline', derived from 'Karlos' meaning man or warrior. The feminine form 'Karline' means 'pure' or 'noble woman'. The name Karlene carries the meaning “Pure, noble woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karlene usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, noble woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
